name: Kiss Facility apresentam o álbum KHAZNA
description: Kiss Facility, a duo featuring Sega Bodega and Mayah Alkhateri, will present their debut album, KHAZNA, in Porto. The album was released in early 2026.
longDescription:
Kiss Facility, a duo formed by producer Sega Bodega and vocalist Mayah Alkhateri, will perform in Porto. They are presenting their first album, KHAZNA, which was released at the start of 2026.

Sega Bodega has a history of collaborations with artists like Björk, FKA twigs, and Caroline Polachek. With Mayah Alkhateri, whose Arab roots influence their music, Kiss Facility has been releasing singles for several years.

The duo will perform at Mouco on November 2, 2026, starting at 21:30.
